reason: We do library storytime, parks and the zoo, and I'm not used to paying for kid activities. With shifts I couldn't promise to get my money's worth out of $59 a month.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? It says ages 8 months to 5 in the same room, and I don't see how that stays calm.
would_change_my_mind: Separate baby/toddler zone or set baby-only hours, plus a free trial visit so I can see how it actually feels before paying.
